Driver:monisha kaltenborn (Monisha Kaltenborn): Austrian Monisha Kaltenborn became the sport's first-ever female team principal when she took over the role at Sauber Formula One Team in 2010.
CEO of Sauber F1 and first female team principal in Formula One.

Driver:peter sauber (Peter Sauber): Former team principal of Sauber F1.
The founder of Sauber who retired.
Team:sauber formula one team (Sauber Formula One Team): Formula One team where Monisha Kaltenborn became the first female team principal.
